title: Anonymized plan-only response assessment

evaluation_basis.behavior_criteria: Must and must_not judgments assess the response’s proposed behavior, not whether actions were executed. A prohibited action is not treated as a violation merely because an explicit refusal is absent.
evaluation_basis.evidence_criteria: Supplied observations, proposed evidence collection, explicit uncertainty, and actual execution evidence are distinguished. Precise next steps and affected-task lists count only where the criterion permits them. No executed-artifact credit is awarded.

status_definitions.pass: Criterion satisfied at its stated plan/content/evidence level.
status_definitions.partial/not demonstrated: Some relevant coverage exists, but a required element or actual evidence is missing.
status_definitions.fail: Response contradicts the criterion or proposes a prohibited action.

evaluation_basis.counts: Unweighted descriptive counts, not an outcome ranking or proof of execution.

overall_judgment: No demonstrated overall winner. Both have 21 pass and 6 partial/not demonstrated judgments, with no fail judgments. Their concrete differences do not resolve their shared rubric gaps.
